title: Project-distributions schema — grounded · constructed · derived
description: Machine-readable form of the project-distributions schema. The canonical prose spec is schema/SCHEMA.md and its illustrated companion is schema/schema-grounded.html; where they and this file differ, SCHEMA.md wins. A node states a `distribution` CONSTRUCTED from a shared corpus of grounded evidence; percentiles are a DERIVED readout (debug_computed_percentiles), never authored. Everything traces to a source. This describes the LOGICAL model, which is stored across two roots (SCHEMA.md §1): `documents` is the source archive's documents.json; `observations`, `general_knowledge` and `speculations` are the data project's corpus/observations.json, corpus/general-knowledge.json and corpus/speculations.json; `nodes` are the data project's projects/*.json, one file per project.

documents.description: The source-identity registry (the archive's documents.json), keyed by doc_<sha256[:12]>.

observations.description: Every observation of the data project (corpus/observations.json), flat, keyed by its id (obs_<id> by convention); each names its document in `doc`.

general_knowledge.description: Broadly-held reference-class priors, keyed by gk_<id>.

speculations.description: Stated-but-unsourced load-bearing guesses, keyed by spec_<id>.

document.description: An archived source's identity: what it is and where its lean text core is. Observations live apart from it (the flat observations map) and point back with `doc` (I12: node → distribution → reference → observation → document).

sha256.description: content hash = identity (the key is doc_<sha256[:12]>); identical bytes are one record. A derivative's is the hash of its derivation.

url.description: where it came from; "" or null when unknown, "" for a derivative

publisher.description: the source's host for an installed source, "derived" for a derivative; may be ""

core.description: path of the lean, searchable text a quote is checked against, relative to the archive (cores/doc_<sha12>.txt); absent while the source has no text layer

capture.description: fetched = the core is extracted from the archived bytes; transcribed = an agent typed the source's content into a text file, so a quote verifies only against that transcription. Absent = not recorded.

capture_corroborated.description: a dated note that a transcribed core was checked against the live page

origin.description: primary = an external source; derivative = composed from other corpus entries by make-derivative. Absent = an external source not yet classified.

derivation_kind.description: derivative only: computed (a reproducible statistic) or reasoning (a judgement over the sources)

derived_from.description: derivative only: the doc_<sha>, doc_<sha>/<obs id>, gk_ or spec_ ids it is derived from; every one resolves (I13)

derivation.description: derivative only: the record its sha256 hashes (I13)

method.description: the statistic (mean, median, p90, cagr, …), or "reasoning"

inputs.description: computed: the records the statistic is computed over

result.description: the computed result or the reasoned conclusion (null for a summary without one)

verification.description: derivative only: written `unchecked` by make-derivative (`unverified` on older records)

audit.description: absent = not audited; verified = passed the audit (mark-audited); flagged = a known defect, not to be used until resolved (with an audit_note)

audit_date.description: the date the audit field was set (YYYY-MM-DD)

audit_note.description: what the audit found or corrected

observation.description: One fact drawn from a document, in the data project's flat observations map. Which nodes use it is derived on demand from projects/*.json (agentic-fetcher/citations.mjs), never stored (I11).

doc.description: the document (a documents.json key) the fact is drawn from

quote.description: verbatim text from the document's core; null only with a capture_note, and then verification is not `verified` (I6)

capture_note.description: present only when quote is null: why there is no verbatim quote

locator.description: where in the document; may be ""

verification.description: verified = non-empty quote present in the core; unchecked = not yet swept (or too short to prove anything); not_in_doc = swept, quote absent; unverifiable = the document has no core yet (should carry blocked_on)

blocked_on.description: with verification = unverifiable: what unblocks it (e.g. an OCR sidecar)

audit.description: the legitimacy audit (audit-evidence): written `unaudited` by add-observation and make-derivative; verified = passed (mark-audited); flagged = a known defect, with an audit_note. check-sources S8 fails while any observation is neither verified nor flagged.

audit_date.description: the date the audit field was set (YYYY-MM-DD)

audit_note.description: what the audit found or corrected

source_capture.description: the document's capture, recorded on the observation when it matters: add-observation writes `transcribed` when the document is a transcription; an audit that re-grounds it on fetched bytes may set `fetched`

derived.description: on the result observation of a derivative document

reasoning.description: why it is admissible without a single citation
why we lean on this un-sourced figure and what would confirm it

measure.description: The superstructure — only the parts the source states; never force-fit a p10/p50/p90 template (I10).

mean.description: arithmetic mean; grounds a splice tail's shape (§4.3)

points.description: named point-measures that are NOT probability quantiles (e.g. gaap/non-gaap margin, milestone shares, a voluntary/involuntary churn split) — one number per named label

series.description: a dated multi-point series; the operand extrapolate_cagr / extrapolate_linear consume

value.description: The recurring trail behind a grounded number (a param, an atom's or anchor's position, an input, a cross_check, a splice point's `at` threshold).

value_type.description: open vocabulary, suggested below. computed_value carries a formula; direct_value (incl. a plain reference to a shared value) takes the number as-is.

reference.description: → obs_ / gk_ / spec_ / in_ by id; null = a counted gap (needs missing_document)

quantile.description: select one quantile (e.g. "p10") of the referenced measure's `quantiles` — for a value that restates one point of a stated distribution (e.g. a scaffolded anchor restating a speculation's authored quantile)

references.description: plural, when the value spans several grounded sources (I7)

formula.description: for a computed_value — ONE grammar over ids AND the distribution's own structure (segments[i], splices[i]), with the closed function set min/max/extrapolate_cagr/extrapolate_linear/slope_match (I22)

basis.description: metric-comparability marker; a metric/unit_of mismatch among a node's operands is flagged, never silently reconciled (I21)

allocation.description: The single mass-split decision on point_mass / weighted_combination.

atom.description: A point-mass atom: a value (the position, via its measure) plus a weight. The one allocation renormalizes the weights (I3).

value.description: optional nested position (else the atom itself is the value)

component.description: A nested distribution plus a weight (weighted_combination).

segment.description: A distribution governing one slice of the support (splice), ordered lower → upper.

splice_point.description: The transition between two consecutive segments. `at` is a position (or a mass fraction for a point-mass boundary), usually referencing a shared value the upper segment's location reuses.

anchor.description: A metalog anchor: an observed sample value (position via its measure; or a nested `value`). Its percentile is its rank i/(n+1), not authored. No weight.

value.description: optional nested value (else the anchor itself is the value)

distribution.description: kind IS the family. Structural: point_mass (atoms), weighted_combination (components), splice (segments+splices). Quantile-parameterized: metalog (anchors + k, optional lower_bound/zero_mass). Parametric families state named params as values. Exact per-kind keys: compiler/DESIGN.md. I2: complete for its kind.

lower_bound.description: metalog lower bound; null = unbounded (alias: boundedness + lower)

upper_bound.description: metalog upper bound; null = unbounded. With lower_bound, gives a doubly-bounded (log-odds) metalog for a fraction/rate whose tail must not cross a ceiling (alias: boundedness + upper)

zero_mass.description: metalog: probability mass sitting at lower_bound — the $0 free-tier hurdle

additionalProperties.description: a parametric kind's named params (median/sigma, alpha/beta, shape/rate, location/scale/shape, etc.), each a value

cross_check.description: A figure that corroborates or refutes the built distribution but anchors no part of it (I18).

superseded_by.description: present only on a refutation — the observation that replaced the disproven claim

node.description: The project-axis distribution the model consumes — an elicited leaf; holds no evidence of its own, only references into the corpus.

inputs.description: node-local named Values (I19: a DAG), keyed by in_<id>

truncation.description: optional — only bounds that actually clip beyond the distribution's natural domain (I16)

reconciliation.description: how multiple / conflicting sources were combined (P5)

support_score.description: how grounded the whole distribution is, overall

reasoning.description: the rationale for support_score — the node's one free-standing narrative

debug_computed_percentiles.description: percentiles/mean read off the distribution — throwaway, recomputable, never authored (I1)
